title: Single Catenary Mooring Line Static Equilibrium
description: Single studless R4 chain catenary mooring line connected from a calm-water surface buoy fairlead to a seabed anchor in 150 m water depth for static tension and touchdown equilibrium.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<sima:Model name="SingleCatenaryMooring">
  <environment waterDepth="150.0" density="1025.0" friction="0.5"/>
  <wave hs="2.5" tp="8.0" gamma="3.3" direction="0.0"/>
  <wind speed="8.0" direction="0.0"/>
  <vessel id="buoy_1" name="CalmBuoy" mass="450000" displacement="460" gmt="2.8" gml="2.8" cgx="0" cgy="0" cgz="-2.5" rxx="6.5" ryy="6.5" rzz="5.0">
    <fairlead id="fl_1" x="4.0" y="0.0" z="-4.0"/>
  </vessel>
  <mooringLine id="line_1" name="R4ChainLine" type="catenary" fairleadId="fl_1" anchorX="450.0" anchorY="0.0" anchorZ="-150.0">
    <segment id="seg_chain" length="520.0" diameter="0.11" dryMass="245.0" subWeight="2100.0" ea="9.5e8" ei="1.0e4" mbl="1.25e7" cd="1.2" cm="2.0"/>
  </mooringLine>
</sima:Model>

title: Semi-Submersible 8-Line Spread Mooring
description: Four-column offshore production semi-submersible platform in 350 m water depth with an 8-line clustered spread mooring pattern under North Sea JONSWAP sea state and surface current.
code:
! SIMO / RIFLEX Card Deck: Four-Column Semi-Submersible 8-Line Spread Mooring
SYS 350.0 1025.0 9.81
BODY semisub_hull NorthSea_Semi 28500000 29200 0.0 0.0 -14.5 34.0 36.0 42.0 5.2 5.8

FAIRLEAD fl_1 semisub_hull  35.0  35.0 -16.0
FAIRLEAD fl_2 semisub_hull  35.0  32.0 -16.0
FAIRLEAD fl_3 semisub_hull -35.0  35.0 -16.0
FAIRLEAD fl_4 semisub_hull -35.0  32.0 -16.0
FAIRLEAD fl_5 semisub_hull -35.0 -35.0 -16.0
FAIRLEAD fl_6 semisub_hull -35.0 -32.0 -16.0
FAIRLEAD fl_7 semisub_hull  35.0 -35.0 -16.0
FAIRLEAD fl_8 semisub_hull  35.0 -32.0 -16.0

CRS r4_chain 0.142 415.0 3520.0 1.45e9 1.2e5 2.05e7 1.2 2.0

LINE line_1 catenary fl_1  820.0  780.0 -350.0
SEGM r4_chain 1250.0 2.05e7
LINE line_2 catenary fl_2  860.0  740.0 -350.0
SEGM r4_chain 1250.0 2.05e7
LINE line_3 catenary fl_3 -820.0  780.0 -350.0
SEGM r4_chain 1250.0 2.05e7
LINE line_4 catenary fl_4 -860.0  740.0 -350.0
SEGM r4_chain 1250.0 2.05e7
LINE line_5 catenary fl_5 -820.0 -780.0 -350.0
SEGM r4_chain 1250.0 2.05e7
LINE line_6 catenary fl_6 -860.0 -740.0 -350.0
SEGM r4_chain 1250.0 2.05e7
LINE line_7 catenary fl_7  820.0 -780.0 -350.0
SEGM r4_chain 1250.0 2.05e7
LINE line_8 catenary fl_8  860.0 -740.0 -350.0
SEGM r4_chain 1250.0 2.05e7

WAVE JONSWAP 9.5 13.8 3.3 30.0
WIND 24.0 30.0
CURR 1.1 15.0
TIME 0.05 3600.0

title: 15 MW Floating Offshore Wind Turbine Coupled Wave-Wind
description: IEA 15 MW UMaine VolturnUS-S semi-submersible floating offshore wind turbine moored with three 850 m R3 studless chains in 200 m depth under rated wind-wave-current excitation.
code:
! SIMO / RIFLEX Model: IEA 15 MW VolturnUS-S Floating Offshore Wind Turbine
SYS 200.0 1025.0 9.81
BODY volturnus_s IEA15MW_FOWT 20093000 20206 0.0 0.0 -14.94 38.5 38.5 41.2 6.8 6.8

FAIRLEAD fl_1 volturnus_s  58.000   0.000 -14.0
FAIRLEAD fl_2 volturnus_s -29.000  50.229 -14.0
FAIRLEAD fl_3 volturnus_s -29.000 -50.229 -14.0

CRS chain_185mm 0.185 685.0 5820.0 3.27e9 1.5e5 2.45e7 1.2 2.0

LINE line_1 catenary fl_1  837.6    0.0 -200.0
SEGM chain_185mm 850.0 2.45e7
LINE line_2 catenary fl_2 -418.8  725.4 -200.0
SEGM chain_185mm 850.0 2.45e7
LINE line_3 catenary fl_3 -418.8 -725.4 -200.0
SEGM chain_185mm 850.0 2.45e7

WAVE JONSWAP 6.5 11.2 3.3 0.0
WIND 11.5 0.0
CURR 0.85 0.0
TIME 0.05 3600.0

    <fairlead id="riser_hangoff" x="92.0" y="0.0" z="-18.0"/>
